findings: FINDING against a remark of the PROOF, not against the statement (DEC-128). Proof of Prop. 2 (l.750–755, p. 244, confirmed on the scan): « le sous-groupe de R^{+p} formé des systèmes de p nombres réels positifs dont le produit est égal à 1. Un élément de ce sous-groupe définit un automorphisme de la structure conique affine du produit » is FALSE when the factors' dimensions differ: in product cone charts (λᵢ) acts as the block homothety diag(λᵢ), of determinant ∏ λᵢ^{dim F(Bᵢ)} (dim F(Bᵢ) = dim Bᵢ + 1; a + 1, b + 1 here), which lies in GU iff ∏ λᵢ^{dim F(Bᵢ)} = 1. Formal: not_isGXMorphism_blockHom_of_ne ((2, 1/2) for a ≠ b), det_eq_one_of_isGXMorphism_blockHom; general p: ProductsGeneral.not_isGXMorphism_piSMul_of_ne, prod_pow_eq_one_of_isGXMorphism_piSMul. The statement of Prop. 2 is true as printed (corrected lift torusPair / piLift); the printed lift is right iff all F(Bᵢ) have one dimension.
